title: De Lima tells China: ‘Walk the talk’ first on peace ahead of Asean
summary: MANILA, Philippines — China should first show its commitment to regional peace through concrete actions before it actively participates in the upcoming Association of Southeast Asian Nations…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China should first show its commitment to regional peace through concrete actions before it actively participates in the upcoming Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit, Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima said. De Lima in a statement on Tuesday said that China cannot yearn to participate in certain Asean discussions
